rows.race_name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Nursery Handicap Stakes (Rider Restricted Race)

selection_reason.summary: Nightbloom improved to win over 6f at Wolverhampton after a breathing operation, and the second and third have won since. She receives 3 lb after Toby Moore's 7 lb claim on Divine Whisper. Lady Blanche won convincingly over 6f at Bath, beating two subsequent winners, and carries 1 lb more than Divine Whisper after the claim. Conciliate has a Yarmouth handicap second and can compete if breaking cleanly after missing the start on his latest run.
selection_reason.counterargument: Divine Whisper drops from Listed company and has the highest official rating, 86. Her effective weight is 9 st 3 lb after Toby Moore's 7 lb claim. Her earlier conditions-race third and the easier company give her a strong winning case on nursery and all-weather debut.
selection_reason.why_still_oppose: Nightbloom's improving, subsequently strengthened winning form and Lady Blanche's proven 6f performance give two specific routes to beating the favourite at the approved lay quote of 3.10.
selection_reason.rival_limitations: Nightbloom must repeat her Wolverhampton Tapeta improvement on Kempton Polytrack. Lady Blanche returns after 187 days and makes her all-weather debut. Conciliate needs to recover from a poor all-weather debut and break on terms.
selection_reason.source: The Racing API Pro and Sporting Life
selection_reason.uncertainty: Moderate racing evidence. Delayed indicative quote, exact quote time and delay unknown. Value and full-stake matching unverified.
